scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us in an office coffee machine: speed, taste quality, ease of use, or maintenance?

options.name: Breville Barista Express Espresso Machine
options.upside: Produces high-quality espresso with built-in grinder
options.tradeoff: Requires regular cleaning and some barista skill
options.concern: May be too complex for casual users
options.best_for: users prioritizing coffee quality and customization

options.name: Keurig K-Elite Single Serve Coffee Maker
options.upside: Very fast and easy to use with wide pod variety
options.tradeoff: Higher cost per cup and less coffee flavor control

options.name: Nespresso VertuoPlus Coffee and Espresso Maker
options.upside: Offers both espresso and larger coffee options with rich crema
options.tradeoff: Capsules are proprietary and more expensive than ground coffee
options.best_for: users wanting versatility between espresso and regular coffee

options.name: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew 2-Way Coffee Maker
options.upside: Flexible brewing with both single cup and full pot options
options.tradeoff: Slower brewing time for full pot and larger footprint
options.concern: Takes more counter space than single-serve machines
options.best_for: users needing flexibility and larger volume brewing
